input.title: Animation: swapParent
input.body:
## Steps to Reproduce

```
- a
  - b
```

1. Set the cursor on `b`
2. Swap Parent

## Current Behavior

No animation.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/cdf4b34a-a3fc-4083-9deb-b5f6e1dbd0ce

## Expected Behavior

- [x] `a` should curve left and `b` should curve right (counter-clockwise) as they animate into their new positions.
- [x] The greater thought (via https://github.com/cybersemics/em/blob/main/src/util/compareThought.ts#L188) should curve right, while the lesser thought should curve left.

## Notes

I recommend [layered animation](https://tobiasahlin.com/blog/curved-path-animations-in-css/) to simulate animating along a curve.
